about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells kids' products.
description: {name} case study: an ecommerce storefront with category pages for activewear, feeding, toys, bath and accessories, plus social creative and ads.
brief: {name} sells kids' products. This page covers an ecommerce storefront spanning the homepage, category pages for activewear, feeding, toys, bath and accessories, and a product detail page.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.
